acceptanceCriteria: gate-ledger keys a declared package by its subtree plus declared entries (and the declaration file) instead of the whole tree, reading the same grammar as tools/gate-affected-select.
A test shows an unrelated tree change keeps a declared package's ledger record valid and a change under a declared entry invalidates it.
body: AFP-V0-023 (V1-0246) declares bounded repository reads for root-locating Go test packages. make gate-ledger -unresolved/-bounds still treat those packages as whole-tree readers, so a declared package reruns on any tree change. Found 2026-10-01 while delivering V1-0246.
title: gate-ledger: honor declared test read scopes in -unresolved and -bounds
